description:
Capture Moments Hands-Free with Bokan™

Capture life's moments easily with the Bokan™ Magnetic Neck Mount. Perfect for adventurers, commuters, and content creators, our neck mount offers great stability and convenience. It works with both phones and action cameras, making it a must-have for better filming.

Strong Magnetic Power: Our advanced magnetic technology features a grip 30% stronger than competitors, with 24 powerful magnets ensuring your device stays securely in place. Perfect for dynamic activities like driving, kayaking, mountain biking, or wave surfing, the Bokan™ Neck Mount keeps your device stable and accessible, no matter the environment.

What’s Inside the Package?

1 x Flexible Neck Holder

1 x Remote Control

1 x Magnetic Phone Adaptor

1 x Action Cam Adaptor

2 x Magnetic Rings (for smartphones without built-in magnets, such as Android phones)

1 x Cleaning Kit (for cleaning the phone case of non-magnetic cell phones before attaching the magnetic ring)

1 x User Manual for Magnetic Neck Mount and Remote

Durability with a 12-Month Warranty: Constructed from high-quality materials (Mounting Base ABS, Neck Mount Silicone and Stainless Steel, Adaptor Bracket Aluminum, Magnetic Rings Iron), the Bokan™ Magnetic Neck Mount is built to last. It won't bend or break, providing dependable support in all conditions. Plus, our 12-month warranty offers free replacements or refunds, ensuring your complete satisfaction and peace of mind.

Wide Compatibility Range: Designed to work seamlessly with a variety of devices, our neck mount is compatible with:

  • iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max
  • iPhone 14, iPhone 14 Pro, iPhone 14 Pro Max
  • iPhone 13, iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 13 Mini, iPhone 13 Pro Max
  • iPhone 12, iPhone 12 Pro, iPhone 12 Mini, iPhone 12 Pro Max
  • Android phones including Samsung Galaxy, LG, Motorola Moto, and Google Pixel series For other cell phones not listed above, simply use the included magnetic rings with the sticker layer for compatibility.

Comfortable and Adjustable: Enjoy the flexibility and comfort of our neck mount, featuring a soft, adjustable arm that can be bent to provide the perfect viewing angle. Its lightweight, ergonomic design ensures maximum comfort even during prolonged use. The quick-release design allows for easy attachment and removal of your phone, and the included cleaning kit helps keep your device and mount clean and safe.

Perfect for GO PRO and INSTA360 Enthusiasts: Enhance your action camera footage with the Bokan™ Magnetic Neck Mount. Designed for hands-free use, it provides unparalleled stability, whether you're capturing your mountain biking trails or wave surfing adventures. It's the ultimate accessory for adventurers and creators, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action.
